english.title: Intent to mislead / defraud person with a copy of the rules of a society which was not a registered society

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: cooperative and community benefit societies act 2014

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with intent to mislead or defraud, gave to **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PERSON..) a copy of the rules of a society, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE SOCIETY..), which was not a registered society on the pretence that they were the rules of a registered society
